text_block_list.text:
To give Cesario a change of pace, I 
brought her to a movie theater, where—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Cesario. Did you come to watch it 
too? "DEAD HEAT SHARK"!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Dead Heat... Shark!? That sounds like a 
completely random title, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
From that reaction, is this your first 
shark movie? This much is completely 
normal, totally. If you'd like... would 
you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...What in the...!? What on earth... am I 
looking at...!?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(A shark... Is that a shark racing down 
the turf...?!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
... To be honest, I'm not even sure how to 
put my thoughts into words...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, in the first place, racing a shark on 
turf is theoretically—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no. If you get bound by common 
sense, you'll ruin the whole thrill!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A shark swimming across the turf at 80 
km/h! Umamusume taking on the challenge 
for peace on the turf! There's no room for 
"how?" here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What you need is imagination! When you 
feel a shark running alongside you on the 
turf, the door to shark movies will swing 
wide open!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today we're watching shark movies 
on loop until you truly appreciate their 
greatness!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(What could Heart-san mean by "the door to 
shark movies"...? It sounds completely 
absurd, yet I can't resist finding out!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(What is this...? The intensity of the 
shark running on the turf... is increasing 
even more than before...?!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list:
It's a great run, but aren't you pushing a 
bit too fast?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Half-baked resolve... won't be enough to 
beat Dead Heat Shark."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing is 'impossible.' I must be fully 
prepared, in case the day comes when I 
have to race a shark."

...It seems Cesario's running has stepped 
into entirely new territory.
